basic_info.description: Rare opportunity to own a Row Home at The Pacific. This townhouse has independent access on tree-adorned Clay Street and its own private sun-drenched patio landscaped with cactus and succulents. Enjoy access to all the 5-star amenities of The Pacific in a townhouse which lives like a single-family house. This 3-story residence includes premium custom finishes and upgrades selected by the owners to create a truly beautiful living experience. Custom cabinetry and built-ins, heated porcelain tile main floor and white oak wood floors on the stair and bedroom levels, floor to ceiling windows with motorized shades, LED lighting and filtered water system throughout. Spa-like principle suite with custom moveable wall is a work of art. Amenities and services include 24/7 security, fitness center, a guest suite and view lounge plus more. Concierge services also include package receiving, shipping and on-demand food and grocery delivery to the unit.
